_comment: Where this workflow's ideas and raw material come from. Free-form — add fields as needed.
_repurpose_hint: own_material is the day-one default. Prefer inputs/queue/ once engine-loop has filled it. One article is usually three or four posts.
_subreddits_hint: Leave empty and the agent finds where your audience actually posts. Add them once you know. Feeds the 4 Reddit subjects in the daily twelve.
_rss_feeds_hint: Media sources that fit your audience — trade press, the newsletters you actually read, competitor blogs, release notes from tools your audience uses, a subreddit's .rss. 10-15 is plenty. Build this list with the agent the first time the daily job runs. Feeds the 4 RSS subjects in the daily twelve.
_rating_criteria_hint: What makes a subject worth posting FOR YOU, in your words. The daily job generates 12 candidates and keeps 1 — this is the bar it filters against. Empty = the agent falls back to the workflow's own 0-9 score (attention, proof, proximity) and says so.
